issues.description: The rewritten aligned-PTE-index lemma exposes its complete higher-level alignment theorem through admit.
issues.rationale: The theorem is used by cursor proofs for every level at or above the chosen alignment level. This snapshot accepts the rewritten relationship between align_down, page-size shifts, and pte_index without a derivation. The direct child repair proves it with checked page-size, division, shift-composition, and alignment reasoning.

issues.description: The rewritten move_forward proof assumes that adding the current page size preserves every higher-level PTE index after carry propagation.
issues.rationale: When move_forward crosses lower-level page-table boundaries, cursor well-formedness requires the higher-level indices through guard_level to remain unchanged once carry terminates. The selected rewritten proof states that quantified property as an assumption. The obligation is older proof debt that previously appeared as two admits; this label is specifically for its modified fb3b9d06 form and does not claim that the underlying debt first originated in fb3b9d06. Later repair ae3200cf removes the assumption and derives the equality using page-size geometry, an alternative PTE-index specification, carry-termination facts, and alignment lemmas.
